Sam R.: Quick experiment idea: small launch to test CTA wording + embed placement for the pricing calculator. goal: which CTA drives more demo bookings vs immediate calc starts.
Priya S.: good call. CTA variants?
Sam R.: Variant A = "Try the calculator" (inline embed), Variant B = "Get a tailored estimate" (gated advanced estimator). 50/50 split.
Evan M.: routing: if gated and domain looks enterprise -> tag:priority_sdr. ops-bot: can you add a rule for domain_match -> tag:priority_sdr?
ops-bot: rule suggested: domain in target_accts => tag:priority_sdr. event created: "pricing-cta-test-3339998888"
Grace L.: landing copy: headline "Estimate inference cost in a minute" subhead "See metered vs committed and expected latency tradeoffs."
Priya S.: FAQ bullets short: Committed: "Predictable monthly price", "Reserved capacity", "SLA & priority support". Metered: "Pay per token", "Autoscale bursts", "Cost-saving tips".
Sam R.: dev snippet (iframe) for inline: <iframe src="https://embed.redwood.ai/pricing-calc?utm=pricing-cta-test-3339998888&variant=try" width="100%" height="520"></iframe>
Sam R.: snippet for gated: <iframe src="https://embed.redwood.ai/pricing-calc?utm=pricing-cta-test-3339998888&variant=tailored&gate=on" width="100%" height="520"></iframe>
Evan M.: tracking: UTM=pricing-cta-test-3339998888; capture variant param and gate flag. SDR CSV: email, company, size_bucket, token_est, utm_variant, lead_tags.
Grace L.: timeline: promo post Mon, registration live Tue, reminder Wed, short webinar Thu (10-15m). Priya + I will QA copy Mon AM.
Priya S.: success metrics: demo bookings >=6% from gated registrants, calc starts lift +10% vs baseline, gated leads quality +18% proxy.
Sam R.: perfect. ops-bot: please publish event id to #ops-alerts and attach rule summary.
ops-bot: posted to #ops-alerts.
Priya S.: thanks team :rocket:
